name: @w6w-apps/pendo
description: Send Pendo track events, read visitor/account/page/feature/guide data, set metadata fields, run aggregation queries, and process GDPR/CCPA deletion requests.

w6w.longDescription:
Pendo is a product analytics and in-app guide platform, and this app covers the parts of its REST API that a workflow actually reaches for: sending track events, reading back visitor, account, page, feature and guide data, setting or reading a metadata field on a visitor or account, running Pendo's own Aggregation pipeline language for analytics queries, pulling a saved report's results, and filing a GDPR/CCPA bulk-deletion request.

The API is really two credentials on five regional deployments. The main Integration Key reads and (optionally) writes everything under `/api/v1`; a separate Track Event Shared Secret — a DIFFERENT value from the integration key — is required for the ingest endpoint on the `data.*.pendo.io` hosts. Getting them mixed up is the most common way a Pendo connection looks broken when it isn't, so this app keeps them as two explicit fields and injects the right one per host.
